submission.justification: S2 has the highest raw significance but fails the robustness constraint. Its validation-region data/MC disagreement is 35%, against a 10% tolerance. Among the strategies that pass, S1 has 6% disagreement and S3 has 3%. S1 gives the higher significance: 3.34 sigma at 60% efficiency, against 2.64 sigma for S3 at 50%. The S1 scan over 30–70% efficiency peaks at 60%, but the differences between 50% and 60% are small. All significances are statistical-only.

requirements.evidence: Highest among robust options: S1 at 60% gives 3.34 sigma (scan: 30%→3.14, 40%→3.24, 50%→3.31, 60%→3.34, 70%→3.22). S3 at 50% gives 2.64. S2 is higher but excluded.
S1 validation-region disagreement is 6%, within the 10% tolerance. S2 (35%) was rejected. Systematic uncertainties were not simulated.

requirements.requirement: Strategy is one of the three in candidate_specs.md
